howto: Press Open the store. Walk to the STOCK ROOM in the top-left and press E to grab a box, carry it to the shelf it matches and press E to restock.
Customers take what the shelves hold, then queue at the checkout. Stand behind the register and press E to scan each one — a scan takes a moment per customer, and a full queue walks out.
Spend takings in the Store Manager panel: unlock pricier product lines, hire a cashier and a stocker, expand the floor, and buy Marketing, Box Size, Shelf Capacity and Register Speed levels.
Your star rating rises with happy customers and falls when shoppers leave angry — it is the live score of the run.
tips: An empty shelf turns shoppers away: keep every unlocked line stocked before unlocking the next one.
Stock costs money up front (Apples $2 per box item, up to Cake) and sales pay more — but only if the shelf is full when a shopper reaches it.
The Cashier ($2,500) scans the queue by himself and the Stocker ($4,000) refills empty shelves: with both hired the mart runs itself and you only step in for the rush.
Register Speed and Marketing compound hardest — more shoppers per minute only pays if the queue actually moves.
Grab a box from the stock room on every trip past it: walking is the slow part, so never make an empty-handed trip.

controls.keyboard: WASD or arrow keys walk; E or Space acts (grab a box, restock a shelf, scan a customer); clicking a spot walks there and acts on what you click.
controls.touch: Tap where you want to go, then tap shelves, boxes and the register. Everything in the Store Manager panel is tap-to-buy.

difficulty: No difficulty modes — one endless store. Pressure comes from the product tiers you unlock and the shopper rate Marketing brings in; a bad minute costs reputation stars but never progress.

features.goals-or-day-targets: Live star rating in the HUD (3 of 5 at the start) plus the XP bar to the next level
features.economy-readout: Money, XP level, stars and served/lost counters across the top; every price and effect is written on its Store Manager card
features.upgrade-path: Store Manager panel: 8 product lines, Marketing / Box Size / Shelf Capacity / Register Speed (5 levels each), Cashier and Stocker hires, and one store expansion
features.end-of-day-summary: No day clock: the panel and toasts report every unlock and hire as it happens, and the hint bar always names the next useful job
